examples.english: They began to play the ball together.
examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.arabic: هم يشربون القهوة معا في الصباح
examples.english: They drink coffee together in the morning.
examples.transliteration: hum yashraboon alqahwa maan fi assabaah

examples.arabic: نشرب الشاي الحار معا ونتكلم بسعادة تحت النجوم
examples.english: We drink hot tea together and talk happily under the stars.
examples.transliteration: nashrabu ash-shay al-harr maan wa-natakallamu bisaada tahta an-nujum.

examples.arabic: شربنا القهوة معا وتحدثنا عن تفاصيل حياتنا اليومية بعد كل هذه السنوات
examples.english: We drank coffee together and talked about the details of our daily lives after all these years
examples.transliteration: Sharibna al qahwa maan wa tahaddathna an tafasil hayatina al yawmiyya bada kulla hadhihi as sanawat
examples.storyTitle: A Surprise Meeting at the Cafe

examples.arabic: هذه عائلتي ونحن نحتفل معا في البيت
examples.english: This is my family and we celebrate together in the house.
examples.transliteration: Hadhihi aailatee wa nahnu nahtafulu maan fee albayt

examples.arabic: البارحة اجتمعنا حول طاولة الطعام لنتناول العشاء معا.
examples.english: Yesterday we gathered around the food table to eat dinner together.
examples.transliteration: Albariha ijtamana hawla tawilat altaam linatanawal alasha maan.
